test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Two trains start at the same time from Agra and Meerut and proceed towards each other at speeds of 16 km/h and 32 km/h, respectively. When they meet, it is found that one train has travelled 64 km more than the other. The distance between the two stations is:
solution:
**Given:**

Speed of Train 1 (S₁) = 16 km/h

Speed of Train 2 (S₂) = 32 km/h

Extra distance traveled by Train 2 = 64 km

Calculation:

Let time taken by both trains to meet = t hours.

Distance traveled by Train 1 = S₁ × t

Distance traveled by Train 2 = S₂ &t
